scope: P2 能力探测深入(无秘密、无认证、无模型调用;方法名从官方发行物只读提取)

deepseekHarness.acpProfile: dsh --profile acp (官方默认profile; @deepseek-ai/dsh-acp-app + @deepseek-ai/dsh-acp, provider deepseek-official, model deepseek-v4-flash)
deepseekHarness.protocol: JSON-RPC over stdio (agent-client-protocol 生态, @agentclientprotocol 在 profile node_modules)
deepseekHarness.assessment: session/resume + session/list 优于Kimi式session/load;取消有明确interrupted→cancelled映射;驱动接入点为 dsh --profile acp
deepseekHarness.blocked: 真实任务/恢复/取消闭环需 DeepSeek DUT 凭据登录(用户动作),挂起为 BLOCKED_BY_CREDENTIALS

zcodeRuntime.protocol: ZCode Protocol, newline-delimited JSON-RPC-ish over stdio; 帧形 {id, method, params} (无 jsonrpc/v 键,实验确认)
zcodeRuntime.assessment: headless自动化/结构化事件/resume/取消齐备;实验级驱动可行;未对协议语义做实现(不猜字段),驱动实现前需对 session/create|send|events 做最小真实往返验证
